title: Progress on the synthesis and applications of the green non-ionic surfactant alkyl polyglycosides
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47333-47359
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06961K, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bo Zhang, Chaolin Yang, Shuting Liao, Xiangqin Lai, Yang Zhang, Binbin Chen, Wuwan Xiong
Alkyl polyglycosides (APGs), synthesized from sugars and fatty alcohols, exhibit low surface tension, good foam, and biodegradability. This review systematically covers their structure–property relationships, synthetic methodologies and applications.
